about_the_game: Casual Cruise is a driving game with a focus on drifiting! The handling of the cars is a mix of realistic and arcade feeling. Players have the freedom to enter and exit any car on the map they wish, and drive and explore around the maps. There is single player and online game mode, currently there are 3 maps to choose from, 10 cars to drive, there is also a climbing mechanic over obstacles. There is first person and third person view with character and in vehicle (cars have 3 cams, third person, cockpit (steering wheel) and roof camera).Developed by a single developer, it's made using the latest technologies of the next-gen game engine Unreal Engine 5.

  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from 2016 or later

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 or newer

short_description: Casual Cruise is a driving and drifting game made using the latest technologies of the next-gen game engine Unreal Engine 5. Players have the freedom to exit and enter any vehicle, so get together with friends and burn some rubber!
